incident-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - runtime crashloop detected in cluster-us-west-2. Alerts triggered from container restarts > 50% on runtime-service. Pager routed to Alex Chen. Incident channel created. https://redwood-status.example/inc/12345

Alex Chen (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing a wave of crashloops on runtime-service-rlm across three GPU nodes (g4dn/*). Containers crash with SIGSEGV during model init. Root ts: 1719876543.

Jia Wang (eng-runtime): logs show segfault in fused_quant_kernel.so calling into TensorRT plugin. Minimal stack:
```
#0 0x7f9a4d2c in fused_quant_kernel::init_trt_plugin()
#1 0x7f9a4d2c in runtime::load_model_variant()
#2 0x7f9a4120 in runtime::serve_loop()
```
Backtraces truncated, but core files present on node-gpu-07.

Marc Rivera (eng-ml): This started right after yesterday's canary where we pushed quant-kernel v1.2.0 -> heavy use of custom int8 kernels + TRT integration. Canary looked fine for short seqs, but long-seq workloads might trigger a null ptr in plugin.

Tim O'Neill (sre): Node flaps observed; kubelet restarted some pods. We're seeing oom_killer activity around same time on one host, but most nodes show SIGSEGV not OOM. Suggest cordon/drain for two affected nodes to isolate.

Alex Chen (oncall): Action items: 1) Support to collect customer impact. 2) Eng to roll back quant-kernel on runtime images or hotfix. 3) SRE to cordon affected nodes and scale up fallback pool. 4) Keep customers informed.

Elaine Park (support): Initial customer reports: 4 dedicated tenants in us-west on dedicated pools reporting 502/timeout spikes since 14:02 UTC. Collecting request IDs. Marking HIGH priority.

Jia Wang (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation: revert runtime image tag to runtime:stable-2026-03-08 for all affected nodes and restart pods. I can push a rollback and update rollout controller to skip canary. Preparing command snippet:
```
kubectl set image deploy/runtime-service runtime=registry.redwood/runtime:stable-2026-03-08 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-service -n prod
```
Do we want to evict pods on nodes or let rollout handle it?

Tim O'Neill (sre): Cordon/drain approach faster to stop new crashes on those GPUs. Then restart pods on healthy nodes that don't have the custom kernel mounted.

Marc Rivera (eng-ml): If rollback isn't fast enough, we can disable TRT-fused path by flipping runtime flag: --disable-trt-fused-kernel which falls back to slower CPU-friendly path (higher latency but stable). That can be toggled via config map.

Alex Chen (oncall): Jia, do rollback. Tim, cordon nodes gpu-05, gpu-07. Marc, stand by to flip flag if rollbacks hit issues. Elaine, assemble impacted tenant list. Priya, prep customer comms draft.

Jia Wang (eng-runtime): Rolling back now. Pushing image tag and monitoring.

incident-bot: action_taken: deployment rollback to runtime:stable-2026-03-08 initiated by Jia Wang at 14:08 UTC.

Tim O'Neill (sre): cordoned nodes: gpu-05, gpu-07. Draining gpu-07 now.

Tim O'Neill (sre): drain command used: `kubectl drain gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n prod`

Elaine Park (support): Affected tenants so far: tenant-alpha, tenant-catalyst, tenant-delta, tenant-zeta. I have request IDs, opening support tickets for each. ETA for customer update: 14:30 UTC.

Marc Rivera (eng-ml): FYI reproducer script that triggers long-seq path attached to thread (shortened):
```
# reproducer outline
python run_inference.py --model redwood/large-int8 --seq-len 4096 --batch 2 --warmup 10
```
This consistently hits the segfault on canary image. Not on stable.

Alex Chen (oncall): Rollback succeeded on 6/8 pods in first wave, rest restarting. Error rates falling from 65% -> 18% in last 5m. Node gpu-07 had core dumps; I'll coordinate secure copy with eng to collect cores.

Jia Wang (eng-runtime): Captured core and coredumpctl output. Uploading to internal blobstore: s3://redwood-incident-dumps/1719876543/cores.tar.gz. Will analyze symbolicated traces.

Marc Rivera (eng-ml): Preliminary cause hypothesis: TRT plugin dereferences an uninitialized pointer when handling INT8 scale arrays for long sequences. Edge-case triggered by batching pattern under production traffic. We'll prepare patch to add guards and more tests.

Priya Singh (product): Noting customer impact: several lower-SLA customers experienced timeouts; no enterprise SLA customers currently reporting major data loss, but ongoing monitoring. Draft comms ready for review.

Elaine Park (support): Sending outbound customer messages now. Internal note: escalate to account teams if dedicated instance affected more than 5% errors per minute.

Tim O'Neill (sre): Uncordoning gpu-05 after drain completed and healthy. Keeping gpu-07 cordoned until postmortem.

incident-bot: Pager resolved for oncall Alex Chen at 14:28 UTC. Incident status: mitigation in progress, rollback reduced crashes. Postmortem requested.

Alex Chen (oncall): Great work. Next steps: engineering to prepare hotfix branch with unit/regression tests, SRE to collect all node-level diagnostics, support/product to finalize customer comms. I'll convert to postmortem doc and assign owners.

Marc Rivera (eng-ml): I'll open PR to add null checks and a unit test for long-seq INT8 path. Will target hotfix-quant-1.2.1.

Jia Wang (eng-runtime): After analysis, we will also add a runtime flag to disable the fused TRT path per-deployment for safer rollouts.

Elaine Park (support): Closing customer tickets as errors drop below threshold; leaving follow-ups for account teams.

Alex Chen (oncall): Closing incident channel shortly and creating postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/example/postmortem/1719876543. Assigning owners: eng-runtime (Jia), eng-ml (Marc), SRE (Tim), Support (Elaine).

Priya Singh (product): We'll include impact summary and plan for controlled re-release. Thanks everyone. :heart:

incident-bot: Incident channel archived at 15:00 UTC per oncall.
